trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own [1].
Work through the roadmap stages in order, starting with the Chapter 1 meditation, so nothing is left for a second playthrough [2].
Expect about 200 hours in total at difficulty 4/10, with A Long Road (100%) the last big gate [2].

steps: Play through every Chapter 1 story mission to the end of the chapter [1].

Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 as a safety net [2].

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
steps: Do the first meditation in Chapter 1: in the morning at Jason's house, talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony when she says she will meditate, and choose Accept [2].
Then meditate at the other spots across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, with Lucia and Jason [2].
Check progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations, and tap + on the counter here for each spot you finish [4].
The last spot needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2 [2].
